issue: Washer would not drain and showed the OE error code.
resolution: Cleaned a clogged drain pump filter behind the lower front panel (a sock was stuck in it).

issue: Brewing took much longer than usual.
resolution: Ran a descaling cycle with a vinegar and water mix.

issue: Dishwasher stopped mid-cycle with the E15 error code.
resolution: Found water in the base pan from a loose drain hose clamp; dried the base pan and re-tightened the clamp.

issue: Standing water left at the bottom after cycles.
resolution: Cleaned the filter assembly and the drain pump cover.
Washed the foam and felt filters and cleared a blockage in the hose.

issue: Washer shook violently during the spin cycle.
resolution: Building maintenance re-leveled the washer and checked the shipping bolts.

issue: Dryer ran but clothes stayed damp after a full cycle.
resolution: Technician cleared a lint blockage in the exhaust vent duct.

issue: Fridge section was warm while the freezer stayed cold.
resolution: Defrosted the iced-over evaporator; the problem came back two weeks later.
